records.context: Aggregate per-cell or per-microplate sample position embeddings into one profile per treatment.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.aggregate_profiles#0
records.source: Aggregate per-cell or per-well embeddings into one profile per treatment.
records.translation: 将逐细胞或逐孔嵌入聚合为每个处理一个特征谱。

records.context: With ``well_columns``, rows (normally cells) are first averaged per microplate sample position by ``well_method``; without, each input row is taken as a microplate sample position, as in the microplate sample position tables :func:`embed_store` writes. The microplate sample positions are then optionally normalised to the control microplate sample positions and combined per treatment (the distinct values of ``by``) by ``method``. This is the microplate sample position-then-treatment profile used for mechanism-of-action benchmarks such as BBBC021: the mean of the cells in a microplate sample position, normalised to the laboratory microplate's DMSO microplate sample positions, and the median of the replicate microplate sample positions.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.aggregate_profiles#1
records.source: With ``well_columns``, rows (normally cells) are first averaged per well by ``well_method``; without, each input row is taken as a well, as in the well tables :func:`embed_store` writes. The wells are then optionally normalised to the control wells and combined per treatment (the distinct values of ``by``) by ``method``. This is the well-then-treatment profile used for mechanism-of-action benchmarks such as BBBC021: the mean of the cells in a well, normalised to the plate's DMSO wells, and the median of the replicate wells.
records.translation: 给出 ``well_columns`` 时，先按 ``well_method`` 将各行（通常是细胞）按孔取平均；未给出时，每个输入行都视为一个孔，就像 :func:`embed_store` 写出的孔表那样。随后可选地将各孔相对于对照孔进行归一化，再合并到每个处理（即 ``by`` 的各个不同取值），合并方式由 ``method`` 指定。这就是 BBBC021 等作用机制基准所用的先孔后处理的特征谱：一个孔内细胞的均值，相对于该板的 DMSO 孔进行归一化，再取重复孔的中位数。

records.context: Normalisation subtracts the control centre and, for the two z-scores, divides by the control spread, on each laboratory microplate when ``plate_column`` is given and over the whole table otherwise. ``"robust_zscore"`` uses the median and the scaled median absolute deviation. Features that do not vary in the controls are dropped by the z-scores. ``"tvn"`` (typical variation normalisation) centres on the controls in the same way and then spheres every microplate sample position with a whitening fitted on all control microplate sample positions (:func:`spacr.batch_correction.spherize_features`, keeping only the directions the controls span).
records.label: spacr.embeddings.aggregate_profiles#2
records.source: Normalisation subtracts the control centre and, for the two z-scores, divides by the control spread, on each plate when ``plate_column`` is given and over the whole table otherwise. ``"robust_zscore"`` uses the median and the scaled median absolute deviation. Features that do not vary in the controls are dropped by the z-scores. ``"tvn"`` (typical variation normalisation) centres on the controls in the same way and then spheres every well with a whitening fitted on all control wells (:func:`spacr.batch_correction.spherize_features`, keeping only the directions the controls span).
records.translation: 归一化会减去对照中心，对于两种 z 分数还会再除以对照离散度；给出 ``plate_column`` 时在每个板上分别进行，否则在整个表上进行。``"robust_zscore"`` 使用中位数和经缩放的中位数绝对偏差。在对照中不变化的特征会被 z 分数剔除。``"tvn"``（典型变异归一化）以同样方式相对于对照居中，然后用在全部对照孔上拟合的白化变换对每个孔进行球化（:func:`spacr.batch_correction.spherize_features`，只保留对照所张成的方向）。

records.context: Score treatment profiles by nearest-neighbour mechanism-of-action accuracy.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.evaluate_moa#0
records.source: Score treatment profiles by nearest-neighbour mechanism-of-action accuracy.
records.translation: 按最近邻作用机制准确率为处理特征谱打分。

records.context: Each labelled treatment is matched to its nearest other treatment by cosine similarity (one nearest neighbour, 1-NN) and counts as correct when the two share a mechanism of action (MoA). Under NSC (not same compound) the neighbour may not be the same compound at another concentration; under NSCB (not same compound or batch) it may also not share a batch, which removes the batch effects that NSC rewards. Treatments left with no candidate are not scored. Accuracy is reported with a Wilson score confidence interval (CI), together with the share of treatments that are solvable (a candidate with the same MoA exists).
records.label: spacr.embeddings.evaluate_moa#1
records.source: Each labelled treatment is matched to its nearest other treatment by cosine similarity (one nearest neighbour, 1-NN) and counts as correct when the two share a mechanism of action (MoA). Under NSC (not same compound) the neighbour may not be the same compound at another concentration; under NSCB (not same compound or batch) it may also not share a batch, which removes the batch effects that NSC rewards. Treatments left with no candidate are not scored. Accuracy is reported with a Wilson score confidence interval (CI), together with the share of treatments that are solvable (a candidate with the same MoA exists).
records.translation: 每个带标签的处理按余弦相似度与其最近的另一个处理匹配（一个最近邻，1-NN），若两者具有相同的作用机制（MoA），则计为正确。在 NSC（非同一化合物）规则下，近邻不能是同一化合物的其他浓度；在 NSCB（非同一化合物或批次）规则下，近邻还不能与其共享批次，从而消除 NSC 会奖励的批次效应。没有候选近邻的处理不参与打分。准确率附带 Wilson 得分置信区间（CI）报告，同时给出可解处理所占的比例（存在具有相同 MoA 的候选）。

records.context: Every table carries control rows: the same rule with MoA labels shuffled between compounds (mean and standard deviation over ``n_permutations``, interval from the permutation percentiles), and the majority class, the accuracy of always guessing the commonest MoA. Profiles from another feature set, for example CellProfiler features, can be scored beside them as reference rows.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.evaluate_moa#2
records.source: Every table carries control rows: the same rule with MoA labels shuffled between compounds (mean and standard deviation over ``n_permutations``, interval from the permutation percentiles), and the majority class, the accuracy of always guessing the commonest MoA. Profiles from another feature set, for example CellProfiler features, can be scored beside them as reference rows.
records.translation: 每张表都带有对照行：在化合物之间打乱 MoA 标签后应用相同规则（取 ``n_permutations`` 次的均值和标准差，区间取自置换百分位数），以及多数类，即始终猜测最常见 MoA 的准确率。来自其他特征集的特征谱（例如 CellProfiler 特征）可以作为参考行与之并列打分。
